name: Fuel Tank
text: Steel tank holding 8,000 L of one fuel. Fill and empty it with jerry cans or any fluid pipe. Shows up to every vehicle, ship and aircraft pump through the shared fuel capability. Age V.

name: Jerry Can
text: Holds 20 L of one fuel. Use on a tank to pour in, sneak-use to draw out, right-click a vehicle to refuel it. Age V.
